title: DafterError
description: Every vendor error is mapped into this taxonomy inside its own provider subpackage, so no vendor exception escapes and callers never branch on a vendor's error shape.

message.description: Human-readable and safe to log. Never contains a name, email, phone number or transcript content.

retryable.description: Whether the caller may retry the same request. Auth and quota failures are not retryable and page someone; transient transport failures are.

provider.description: Provider request IDs are what make vendor support tickets actionable.

details.description: Located sub-problems, one per line, each naming the JSON pointer it failed at. A validation failure that reports only 'the document is invalid' makes the config gate unusable, so the individual failures are carried rather than collapsed.
